Manage weekly and monthly reports to provide timely quality performance results to management (balance scorecard KPI goals info). Provide technical input to team from a quality viewpoint. Associate Degree (or higher) in a Technical Field or Business Management combined with related experience

Strong organization and computer skills in utilizing Microsoft Office Software (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

2+ Years of experience in a manufacturing environment

The candidate must possess the physical ability to climb stairs and move between the various pieces of equipment they are responsible to operate

The role also involves staying in regular contact with internal and external customers on quality issues, and creating and managing Process Flow diagrams and control plans.
cond_0087.responsibilities:
Position is the lead internal auditor and one of the main contacts for the ISO/IATF audits — actively engaging with auditors and communicating findings clearly.
Create, evaluate, and audit corrective actions, regularly connecting with relevant teams to drive resolution.
Make procedural changes to Work Instructions and other ISO/IATF documents.
Investigate and take a lead role in correcting problems causing non-conforming product, working closely with others to clarify root causes and walk teams through corrective steps.
Manage weekly and monthly reports to provide timely quality performance results to management (balance scorecard KPI goals info).
Provide technical input to the team from a quality viewpoint, speaking up to explain trade-offs and raise issues early.
Team member of the FMEA team, actively contributing to discussions.
Participate in the use of Statistical Process Control (SPC).
cond_0087.requirements:
Associate Degree (or higher) in a Technical Field or Business Management combined with related experience a must.
Certified training for ISO 9001 / IATF 16949.
Possess a solid understanding of automotive quality practices (AIAG).
2+ Years of experience in a manufacturing environment a plus.
Innovative, self-motivated and possess excellent problem identification/definition, planning, interpersonal communication, and group process skills.
Comfortable initiating contact and communicating clearly with team members and stakeholders on a regular basis.
Ability to operate with minimal supervision.
Strong organization and computer skills in utilizing Microsoft Office Software (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
The candidate must possess the physical ability to climb stairs and move between the various pieces of equipment they are responsible to operate.
The candidate must be able to lift up to approximately 40 pounds (flat test samples) and possess the ability to hear and speak clearly and over the plant radio and intercom systems.
cond_0087.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0297.intro: The Quality Engineer works with the team to maintain conformance with the Business Management Plan and its compliance to ISO 9001 and IATF 16949. This position coordinates internal audits for the quality system, supports the corrective action process, helps establish and maintain quality assurance procedures, and works with others to manage the document control system. The role also involves collaborating on internal and external customer quality issues and working alongside the team on Process Flow diagrams and control plans.
cond_0297.responsibilities:
Position works as the lead internal auditor and one of the main contacts for ISO/IATF audits, coordinating with relevant stakeholders throughout the process.
Collaborate on corrective actions — creating, evaluating, and auditing them together with the team.
Work with others to make procedural changes to Work Instructions and other ISO/IATF documents.
Coordinate with cross-functional partners to investigate and help correct problems causing non-conforming product.
Support management by preparing weekly and monthly reports to share timely quality performance results (balance scorecard KPI goals info).
Contribute technical input to the team from a quality viewpoint.
Participate as a team member of the FMEA team.
Work alongside the team in the use of Statistical Process Control (SPC).
cond_0297.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate Degree (or higher) in a Technical Field or Business Management combined with related experience
Certified training for ISO 9001 / IATF 16949
Solid understanding of automotive quality practices (AIAG)
Strong organization and computer skills using Microsoft Office Software (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Interpersonal communication and group process skills
Ability to operate with minimal supervision
Physical ability to climb stairs, move between equipment, lift up to approximately 40 pounds (flat test samples), and hear and speak clearly over plant radio and intercom systems
Preferred Requirements
2+ Years of experience in a manufacturing environment
Innovative approach to problem identification and definition
Planning and organizational skills beyond standard requirements

As well as address internal and external customer quality issues, creating and managing Process Flow diagrams and control plans.
cond_0390.responsibilities: Position is the lead internal auditor and one of the main contacts for the ISO/IATF audits. Create, Evaluate and Audit corrective actions. Make procedural changes to Work Instructions and other ISO/IATF documents. Investigate and take a lead role in correcting problems causing non-conforming product. Manage weekly and monthly reports to provide timely quality performance results to management (balance scorecard KPI goals info). Provide technical input to team from a quality viewpoint. Team member of the FMEA team. Participate in the use of Statistical Process Control (SPC).
cond_0390.requirements:
Associate Degree (or higher) in a Technical Field or Business Management, or equivalent practical experience. Certified training for ISO 9001 / IATF 16949, or willingness to obtain. Some background in automotive quality practices (AIAG) is helpful. Around 2 years of experience in a manufacturing environment, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant training. Ability to communicate effectively, work with some independence, and stay organized. Openness to problem-solving and willingness to develop planning and interpersonal skills. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Software (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
Physical Requirements: The candidate must possess the physical ability to climb stairs and move between the various pieces of equipment they are responsible to operate. The candidate must be able to lift up to approximately 40 pounds (flat test samples) and possess the ability to hear and speak clearly and over the plant radio and intercom systems.
cond_0390.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

As well as address internal and external customer quality issues, creating and managing Process Flow diagrams and control plans.
cond_0460.responsibilities: Position is the lead internal auditor and one of the main contacts for the ISO/IATF audits. Create, Evaluate and Audit corrective actions. Make procedural changes to Work Instructions and other ISO/IATF documents. Investigate and take a lead role in correcting problems causing non-conforming product. Manage weekly and monthly reports to provide timely quality performance results to management (balance scorecard KPI goals info). Provide technical input to team from a quality viewpoint. Team member of the FMEA team. Participate in the use of Statistical Process Control (SPC).
cond_0460.requirements:
Associate Degree (or higher) in a Technical Field or Business Management combined with related experience a must. Certified training for ISO 9001 / IATF 16949. Possess a solid understanding of automotive quality practices (AIAG). 2 + Years of experience in a manufacturing environment a plus. Innovative, self-motivated and possess excellent problem identification/definition, planning, interpersonal communication, and group process skills. Ability to operate with minimal supervision. Strong organization and computer skills in utilizing Microsoft Office Software (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
The candidate must possess the physical ability climb stairs and move between the various pieces of equipment they are responsible to operate. The candidate must be able to lift up to approximately 40 pounds (flat test samples) and possess the ability to hear and speak clearly and over the plant radio and intercom systems.

Creates, evaluates, and audits corrective actions.
Makes procedural changes to Work Instructions and other ISO/IATF documents.
Investigates and takes a lead role in resolving problems causing non-conforming product.
Manages weekly and monthly reports to deliver timely quality performance results to management (balance scorecard KPI goals).
Provides technical input to the team from a quality viewpoint.
Participates as a member of the FMEA team.
Participates in the use of Statistical Process Control (SPC).
cond_0646.requirements:
Associate Degree (or higher) in a Technical Field or Business Management combined with related experience required.
Certified training for ISO 9001 / IATF 16949.
Solid understanding of automotive quality practices (AIAG).
2+ Years of experience in a manufacturing environment a plus.
Strong problem identification and definition skills, with the ability to plan and work through issues methodically.
Clear written communication and direct verbal reporting skills.
Ability to operate with minimal supervision.
Strong organization and computer skills in Microsoft Office Software (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
Must possess the physical ability to climb stairs and move between various pieces of equipment.
Must be able to lift up to approximately 40 pounds (flat test samples).
Must be able to hear and speak clearly, including over plant radio and intercom systems.
